service.name: SceneResource_LoadInitialC000AndPaletteSources
service.input: A0 points to the active-scene initialization block at ROM 0x00129CAA.
behavior: Copies 0x20 words from A0 through VDP_DATA.
Restores the caller's D0 word before returning.

source.role: initial C000 transfer block and two 16-word palette source bands

conclusion: The former anonymous helper is the active-scene initialization transfer for the initial C000 block and its first two palette source bands. The higher-level visual identity of the block remains unassigned.
